```yaml
name: Claude Auto-Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-review:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.comment.body == '@claude review')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup project context
        run: |
          cat > project_context.md << 'EOF'
          # Reown Docs Architecture & Review Guidelines

          ## Project Overview
          This repository contains documentation for Reown's ecosystem, including AppKit, WalletConnect Modal, and Cloud services. The documentation is built with Mintlify and follows a structured MDX-based approach.

          ## Content Structure
          - Root level documents provide high-level overviews
          - Advanced topics are organized under `/advanced/`
          - AppKit specific documentation lives under `/appkit/`
          - Cloud services documentation is under `/cloud/`
          - Snippets and reusable content are in `/snippets/`

          ## Domain Knowledge Requirements
          - Web3/Multichain expertise required
          - Understanding of wallet connection flows
          - Knowledge of smart contract interactions
          - Familiarity with EVM, Solana, Bitcoin networks
          - Understanding of authentication patterns (SIWX, Social Login)
          - Awareness of payment flows (Onramp, Swaps, Deposits)

          ## Review Focus Areas
          1. Technical accuracy of code examples
          2. Clarity and completeness of instructions
          3. Consistency in terminology and naming conventions
          4. Proper use of Markdown/MDX syntax
          5. Tone of voice compliance (see reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md)
          6. Grammar and spelling correctness
          7. Link validity and proper formatting
          8. Content organization and navigation flow

          ## Tone of Voice Enforcement
          All PRs must comply with the official Reown tone of voice guidelines. Claude must enforce these rules during reviews.
          EOF

      - name: Add tone of voice extract
        run: |
          cat > reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md << 'EOF'
          # Reown Official Tone of Voice Guidelines

          ## Core Principles
          - Professional yet approachable
          - Clear and concise technical explanations
          - Consistent terminology throughout documentation
          - Audience-focused communication

          ## Writing Style
          - Use active voice
          - Prefer simple, direct language
          - Avoid jargon unless necessary
          - When jargon is needed, provide clear definitions
          - Maintain consistent capitalization and punctuation

          ## Technical Communication
          - Be precise with technical terms
          - Provide context for complex concepts
          - Use step-by-step instructions where appropriate
          - Include code snippets with proper syntax highlighting
          - Reference relevant APIs and SDKs clearly

          ## Audience Considerations
          - Cater to developers of varying experience levels
          - Assume basic understanding of Web3 concepts
          - Provide links to foundational resources when needed
          - Balance depth with accessibility

          ## Review Process
          - Every PR must pass tone of voice compliance checks
          - Any deviations from these guidelines must be flagged
          - Suggested improvements should align with these principles
          EOF

      - name: Run Claude Auto-Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude review"
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          settings: |
            {
              "prompt": "You are a technical documentation reviewer. Please review this pull request for the Reown documentation repository. Your review should focus on:\n\n1. Technical accuracy of code examples and instructions\n2. Clarity and completeness of explanations\n3. Consistency in terminology and naming conventions\n4. Proper use of Markdown/MDX syntax\n5. Compliance with Reown's official tone of voice (refer to reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md)\n6. Grammar and spelling correctness\n7. Validity and proper formatting of links\n8. Overall content organization and navigation flow\n\nFor each point, provide specific feedback with suggestions for improvement. Ensure all feedback aligns with the tone of voice guidelines.",
              "include_comments_by_actor": true,
              "exclude_comments_by_actor": ["dependabot[bot]", "github-actions[bot]"]
            }
```
